hook: i thought i just wasn't photogenic
caption: turns out i was fine and my phone was the one with the problem.
why: the most common belief in the audience, overturned

hook: rip to every photo i deleted
caption: three years of perfectly good pictures gone because of bad lighting. i'm grieving.
why: shared regret; funny and a bit sad

hook: the photo my friend posted without asking
caption: couldn't make her delete it so i made my own version. she's reposting mine now.
why: petty, specific story every girl has lived

hook: my dating profile was a crime scene
caption: same face, same personality, different light. i finally don't hate my first photo.
why: self-deprecating bold claim about a real stake

hook: why tf do i look like that
caption: the camera, apparently. it was the camera this whole time.
why: exact thing people say out loud at their phone

hook: i keep flipping between these two
caption: same photo. i've checked nine times. it's the same photo.
why: mirrors what the viewer is doing with the loop

hook: choosing my first photo, send help
caption: three options, one of me. which one would you actually swipe on.
why: asks strangers to judge; they always will

hook: works on every photo i hate
caption: the three i'd banned from the internet. they're unbanned.
why: consistency claim tested on her worst photos

hook: good, better, best: tagged photos edition
caption: good is what she tagged me in. best is what i'm replacing it with.
why: tagged-photo dread is universal

hook: which one says i'm normal and fun
caption: same photo four ways for my profile. number please, i've lost perspective.
why: funny brief; comments love playing matchmaker

hook: i tested three on my actual profile
caption: third place looked like i was trying. first place looked like i wasn't. that's the goal.
text: filters ranked for a dating profile
why: real test framing; useful to anyone on the apps

hook: photos i almost never posted
caption: all four sat in my camera roll for months. one filter later, here they are.
why: rescued-photos dump; relatable hoarding

hook: it's a three month old photo
caption: slide two is the edit. slide three is what i'd been sitting on since august.
why: friend's reaction is the proof; reveal undercuts it

hook: i sent her the edited one
caption: she asked what phone i have. same one as her.
text: send me the one of you from saturday
why: tiny everyday moment with a smug ending

hook: what i wish i'd known
caption: i used to retake until my arm hurt. this is one take.
text: don't retake it forty times. take it once, fix the light after. you look fine, the room doesn't.
why: kind, practical, and quotable last line

hook: me according to my phone vs me
caption: top is what the camera decided. bottom is what my friends say i look like.
why: names the gap between mirror and camera

hook: since when are you photogenic
caption: my sister commented this and i'm choosing honesty.
why: sibling roast plus instant confession

hook: cropped myself out of the group pic
caption: then i fixed my half instead and now i'm the one posting it.
why: everyone has cropped themselves out once

hook: my sister said my profile needed help
caption: she was right, which i hate. this is the same photo after one tap.
why: sibling honesty is a relatable trigger

hook: nobody told me you could just do this
caption: i've been retaking photos for an hour at a time like it's 2015.
why: surprise and mild outrage; testimonial energy

hook: never saw myself the way my friends do
caption: they always said i looked nice in person. i finally have a photo that agrees.
why: emotional core of the product, said plainly

hook: everyone else got the good lighting
caption: i was standing in the one bad spot, as usual. fixed it from the sofa.
why: group-photo injustice with a lazy fix

hook: guess which one was on my profile
caption: for eight months. eight. nobody said anything.
why: guessing hook; the wrong answer is the joke

hook: it keeps getting better and i'm scared
caption: three filters in and i no longer recognise my own camera roll. in a good way.
why: escalation framed as genuine disbelief

hook: all the photos my friends took of me
caption: they try, bless them. one filter across all three and i forgive everyone.
why: friends-can't-take-photos is evergreen

hook: my christmas party photo, three attempts
caption: good is what the camera gave me. i did not accept that.
why: seasonal, and the stubbornness is funny

hook: be honest which one looks like me
caption: i genuinely can't tell any more. number in the comments, kind but honest.
why: sincere question; people answer sincere questions

hook: i sent three to the group chat
caption: number one got full caps. number three got a thumbs up, which is violence.
why: group chat as judge; thumbs-up joke travels

hook: proof i went outside this winter
caption: i did not. these are old photos with snow day on them. don't tell my mom.
why: faking cute winter pics, admitted out loud

hook: first photo rule
caption: learned this the slow way so you don't have to.
text: your first photo should look like a good day, not a photoshoot. warm light, nothing else changed.
why: clear rule for a high-stakes photo; saveable

hook: old profile pic. new profile pic.
caption: same photo, i promise. i just stopped letting my camera have the final say.
why: reads instantly; same-photo twist in caption

hook: why do you look better than us
caption: they found out in the comments so i may as well say it here.
why: friends calling her out, then the confession

hook: when you finally like a photo of yourself
caption: took me 24 years and one app. i've looked at it an embarrassing number of times.
why: when-you-finally opening; quietly emotional

hook: this is your sign to redo your profile
caption: i changed one photo and my friend asked if i'd had a shoot. i had not.
why: direct nudge with a believable anecdote

hook: flash photos used to be my enemy
caption: everyone else looked good in flash. the answer was a filter and nobody thought to mention it.
why: party-season flash panic, solved; very relatable
